events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Stand back and stay quiet. This colt's already been fought twice today, and a rope answers to whoever asks it right, not whoever shouts loudest.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: There. Loaded easy, no whip, no rush. He'll remember being asked instead of forced, and so will I.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Better pay and my own say. That's the only offer I was ever going to take. My rope, my terms.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: I run hot and I know it. You didn't flinch and you didn't try to cool me down. Keep doing that.
